releaseNotes:
LifeOS v3.4.0 (Build 77):
• Zero-Lag Compositor Engine: Completely eliminated dock backdrop blur for butter-smooth 60/120 FPS scrolling across all devices.
• Hardware-Accelerated Calorie Ring: Precomputed SVG paths and removed SVG filters for 100% GPU rendering.
• GPU Native TabBar Slider: Replaced layout projection with GPU-accelerated CSS translate3d spring transitions.
• Mobile Viewport Meal Card Refinement: Streamlined actions and non-wrapping meal time intervals for perfect clearance on narrow screens.
• Tier 1 Flagship OLED Polish: Ultra-deep ambient drop shadows and seamless borderless surfaces.
